<description>
This applies the txindex key scheme from #35531 to `txospenderindex`. The motivation is to save space and to allow replicating what #36002 does for `txindex`, by referencing blocks instead of local files.

The first commits refactor the index code so the #35531 scheme can be shared: `BaseIndex::DB` can opt in to the versioned sync locator, and the block sequence keys, sequence assignment and salted hasher move from txindex into `index/block_seq.h`, without changing txindex's on-disk format. The following commits switch txospenderindex to the new keys and add tests. As in txindex, entries of disconnected blocks are kept and lookups only count blocks in the active chain, so `CustomRemove` is gone. Entries written by v31 are still read as a fallback. The last commit makes `FindSpender` skip candidates it cannot read and return `std::optional`, mimicking `TxIndex::FindTx`, since with 5-byte prefixes an unreadable false positive could otherwise hide the real spender.

Each entry is about 33% smaller (key bytes):

- before: 's' (1) + SipHash-2-4 of the outpoint (8) + CDiskTxPos, as varints nFile (2) + nPos (4) + nTxOffset (3) = 18 bytes
- after: 'x' (1) + SipHash-1-3-UJ prefix (5) + block sequence varint (3) + tx offset (3) = 12 bytes

I did not have time to do a benchmark (my setup is really cheap, laptop where i work with an external SSD connected), will try to do on the next days. But same as #35531 i hope to reduce disk space and indexing time.
</description>

<commits>
53566bf296 index: let indexes opt in to a versioned sync locator

Move the best_block_v2 locator handling from TxIndex::DB into
BaseIndex::DB behind a constructor flag, so other indexes can reuse
it when they change their on-disk format.

f3b1bef792 refactor: move block sequence keys to index/block_seq.h

Make the key prefix a template parameter so other indexes can reuse
them.

Not in db_key.h, which holds the height-based scheme of
blockfilterindex and coinstatsindex.

e2a3182e45 refactor: move block sequence assignment and hasher salt to block_seq

Move the logic that assigns a sequence number to a newly indexed block
and the creation of the salted hasher out of TxIndex::DB into free
functions in block_seq, so other indexes using the same scheme can
share them.

007650b331 txospenderindex: key entries by block sequence instead of disk position

Use the txindex key scheme: a 5-byte salted hash of the spent outpoint,
followed by the block sequence and the offset of the spending tx.

As in txindex, entries of disconnected blocks are kept, so CustomRemove
goes away and FindSpender only returns spends in the active chain.

Fall back to the legacy entries if no spend is found.

21772d62ec test: cover txospenderindex hash collisions, reorgs and legacy entries

Pin the encodings of the new and legacy keys, and add unit tests for
hash prefix false positives, for entries of disconnected blocks being
kept but not returned, and for the fallback to legacy entries. Add a
functional test that upgrades a v31 datadir, reorgs a block indexed in
the legacy format and downgrades again.

fadf210822 txospenderindex: skip unreadable candidates in FindSpender

Mimic TxIndex::FindTx: skip a candidate that cannot be read and return
std::optional. With 5-byte hash prefixes collisions are no longer
negligible, and failing on an unreadable false positive would hide the
real spender.
</commits>
